visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A massive calico cat with white, orange, and black fur is lying down on the curved, silver metallic roof of the Taipei Dome. The cat has its eyes closed in a peaceful, napping expression. Three dark grey pigeons are perched on the ledge of the dome in front of the cat's large white paws. The setting is a bright urban environment under a clear blue sky with white clouds; the Taipei 101 skyscraper is clearly visible in the distant background to the right. The lighting is bright and natural daylight, casting soft shadows on the building's facade. (2) The cat opens its eyes and shifts its head slightly to look toward the right. Suddenly, a flock of several more pigeons flies into the frame from the right side, flapping their wings as they pass between the camera and the giant cat. The three pigeons on the ledge remain still. The camera remains completely static throughout the sequence, capturing the surreal scale of the cat relative to the landmark building.
